# Content types (cms-admin)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`content-editing`](../../flows/content-editing/FLOW.md), [`schema-builder`](../../flows/schema-builder/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

Reads the content type catalog (`ContentType`: slug, `displayName`, kind, draft and publish flag, fields) that the content menu, list and edit pages build on. It also checks a candidate definition with `POST /content-types/validate` for the schema builder (D24).

## Techniques

`useDefinitionValidation(definition, mode)` waits `SCHEMA_VALIDATE_DEBOUNCE_MS` after the last change, posts the serialized definition and keeps the last result while a newer check runs; `isResultCurrent` is true only for a successful check of the current definition; a failed call is `unavailable` until `retry`. The validator rules stay in cms-api (D24). `displayName` is the only name shown to people, the slug stays in routes and API calls.

## Technologies

axios (through the shared API client).

## Entry points

`index.ts` exports `getContentTypes`, `useDefinitionValidation`, `useContentTypesApi`, `ContentTypesApiProvider` and the model and check types; `contentTypesFeature` registers the `createContentTypesApi` service.

## Where to change what

A new key in the content type view: add it to `ContentType` in `ContentTypes.api.ts` (additive). A new call: add it to `createContentTypesApi`.
